title: Mycelix Passive Solver Boundary Binding Provenance v3

external_boundary_handle.description: Opaque adapter-resolved solver boundary handle for the mapped solver entity.

candidate_mesh_digest.description: Exact digest of the TriangleMesh representation supplied to the adapter.

boundary_patch_digest.description: Digest of the independently certified candidate-surface interface rim; this is not a solver face/patch identity.

boundary_matching_tolerance_micrometers.description: Tolerance used to certify the candidate-surface interface rim, recorded in micrometers so the selection decision is reproducible.

evidence_level.description: Evidence level stamped only by sealed orchestration. AdapterAttested attests checked adapter binding construction; SolverEntityAttested additionally records an adapter-reported concrete solver-entity fingerprint. Neither establishes solver execution, numerical validity, or physical transport.

solver_entity_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the concrete solver-side boundary entity reported by a live-capable adapter; presence requires SolverEntityAttested.

solver_entity_mapping_digest.description: Digest binding the solver-side entity fingerprint to the exact interface, semantic candidate, exact candidate mesh, realized candidate-surface rim, and external handle.
